interpretation: Initial HTTP 400 fixture cannot validate fallback because the existing code returns before native fallback on 4xx. The subsequent enabled case was additionally blocked by the breaker opened by the disabled case.
Corrected HTTP 503 fixture used a successful one-page recovery probe after cooldown, then four enabled and four disabled pages. Both four-page assertions passed; total mock requests 9.
The combined corrected run later failed on the DOCX fixture; its pass=false is preserved. Office and paper were verified independently instead of rerunning already-passed cases.

Original DOCX lacked word/_rels/document.xml.rels required by installed docx-rs 0.4.19; the original failure and file were retained. Adding that one ZIP part left all 12,000 paragraphs unchanged. The corrected native upload passed; readonly database verification found all paragraph numbers 0..11999 in order.
The Office business-read maximum was 184 ms (8 samples); no backend-only attribution or improvement claim is supported.
The PDF inputs reached completed_with_issues because OCR was deliberately off for scanned documents; all preview pages were saved. This does not test the P1 mixed-upload lock cycle.
